name: @vipentti/planlet
description: Repository-local planning and task management for AI coding agents: focused Markdown planlets plus a deterministic CLI and portable agent skills. Small plans. Clear handoffs.
author: Ville Penttinen

scripts.skills:update: npm run build && node dist/planlet.mjs update --tools all
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js knip.json ".github/workflows/*.yml" README.md CHANGELOG.md RELEASING.md planlet_design.md tests/fixtures/skills/scenarios.json "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "scripts/**/*.mjs"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.js knip.json ".github/workflows/*.yml" README.md CHANGELOG.md RELEASING.md planlet_design.md tests/fixtures/skills/scenarios.json "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" "scripts/**/*.mjs"
scripts.release:verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run type-check && npm run knip && npm test && npm run skills:update && git diff --exit-code
